panels.title: 成本与收入（北京时间按天；成本约 10–30 分钟后补齐）
模型成本（美元）
panels.description: 状态栏、记忆栏每次模型调用补到的花费合计：首发、兜底、报错、超时、拿到了但没被采用的都算（OpenRouter 实际花费 / Surplus 买家成本 / 少量估算）。还在等补的、查不到的不计入，见「成本补齐率」和下方表格的待补 / 缺失。北京时间日界；近7天含今天。2026-11-26 发布前没有成本数据。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE day_cn = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date), 0) AS "今天",
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "近7天"
FROM analytics.panel_call_costs
WHERE dispatched_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')

panels.title: 星尘收入
panels.description: 「立即更新」成功扣的星尘（含专项星尘），每次 6 星尘；没更新出内容的不扣，余额不足的不扣。自动更新不收费。不折算成现金。2026-11-26 收费上线起才有。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged' AND day_cn = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date), 0) AS "今天",
  COALESCE(SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged'), 0) AS "近7天"
FROM analytics.panel_refresh_revenue
WHERE charged_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')

panels.title: 每 1 美元成本换回星尘
panels.description: 星尘收入 ÷ 模型成本美元。成本含自动更新（平台补贴）和手动更新的全部调用，所以这是整个状态栏 / 记忆栏的回本比；只看手动更新的单次账见下方表格「每次收费成本」。成本为 0 时不显示。不做货币折算，按你自己的星尘单价判断。

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE day_cn = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) AS today, SUM(cost_usd) AS week
  FROM analytics.panel_call_costs
  WHERE dispatched_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
), r AS (
  SELECT SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged' AND day_cn = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) AS today,
         SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged') AS week
  FROM analytics.panel_refresh_revenue
  WHERE charged_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN c.today > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.today, 0) / c.today END AS "今天",
  CASE WHEN c.week > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.week, 0) / c.week END AS "近7天"
FROM c CROSS JOIN r

SELECT

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged') AS "近7天"
FROM analytics.panel_refresh_revenue

panels.title: 成本补齐率
panels.description: 30 分钟前发出的面板调用里，已经补到成本（实际或估算）的占比。更近的还在排队补，不算进来。低于 97% 说明有调用查不到花费（看下方「缺失」），成本会被低估。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE day_cn = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AND cost_state IN ('known', 'estimated'))::float
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE day_cn = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date), 0) AS "今天",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_state IN ('known', 'estimated'))::float
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "近7天"
FROM analytics.panel_call_costs
WHERE dispatched_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
  AND dispatched_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'

panels.title: 近 14 天每天模型成本（美元，按状态栏 / 记忆栏 × 自动 / 手动堆叠）
panels.description: 每天（北京时间）补到的模型花费，柱高 = 当天总成本。自动 = 回复后自动更新（平台补贴），手动 = 玩家点「立即更新」。含首发、兜底和没被采用的调用。今天的柱子会随补查继续长高；发布当天只有半天数据。

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT generate_series((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 13, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day_cn
), c AS (
  SELECT day_cn,
    SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE panel = 'status' AND panel_trigger = 'auto') AS sa,
    SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE panel = 'status' AND panel_trigger = 'manual') AS sm,
    SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE panel = 'memory' AND panel_trigger = 'auto') AS ma,
    SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE panel = 'memory' AND panel_trigger = 'manual') AS mm
  FROM analytics.panel_call_costs
  WHERE dispatched_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 13)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
  GROUP BY day_cn
)
SELECT d.day_cn::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS time,
  c.sa AS "状态栏·自动", c.sm AS "状态栏·手动",
  c.ma AS "记忆栏·自动", c.mm AS "记忆栏·手动"
FROM d LEFT JOIN c USING (day_cn)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 近 14 天每天星尘收入（立即更新扣费）
panels.description: 每天（北京时间）「立即更新」成功扣的星尘，含专项。与上图同一时间轴，对照着看。

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT generate_series((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 13, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day_cn
), r AS (
  SELECT day_cn, SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged') AS rev
  FROM analytics.panel_refresh_revenue
  WHERE charged_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 13)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
  GROUP BY day_cn
)
SELECT d.day_cn::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS time, r.rev AS "星尘收入"
FROM d LEFT JOIN r USING (day_cn)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 近 14 天每天对照（今天在最上面）
panels.description: 收入侧：星尘收入 / 收费次数 / 专项星尘（其中用专项扣的）/ 余额不足（被拦下、没扣的次数）。成本侧：总成本 = 自动 + 手动；「每次收费成本」= 手动触发的全部调用花费 ÷ 收费次数，即每收一次 6 星尘背后的平均花费（含没更新出内容、没收费的手动更新）。「星尘 / $」= 星尘收入 ÷ 总成本。「报错超时成本」= 调用了但没返回可用结果的花费。待补 = 还在等补查的调用数；缺失 = 永久查不到花费的调用数（不当 0 算进成本）。空白 = 那天还没有成本数据。

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT generate_series((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 13, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day_cn
), c AS (
  SELECT day_cn,
    COUNT(*) AS calls,
    SUM(cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE panel_trigger = 'auto') AS cost_auto,
    SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE panel_trigger = 'manual') AS cost_manual,
    SUM(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE NOT returned) AS cost_failed,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_state = 'pending') AS pending,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_state = 'missing') AS missing
  FROM analytics.panel_call_costs
  WHERE dispatched_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 13)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
  GROUP BY day_cn
), r AS (
  SELECT day_cn,
    SUM(credits) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged') AS rev,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged') AS charges,
    SUM(bonus_credits) FILTER (WHERE status = 'charged') AS bonus,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS insufficient
  FROM analytics.panel_refresh_revenue
  WHERE charged_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 13)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
  GROUP BY day_cn
)
SELECT
  to_char(d.day_cn, 'MM-DD') || ' 周'
    || (ARRAY['日','一','二','三','四','五','六'])[EXTRACT(DOW FROM d.day_cn)::int + 1] AS "日期",
  COALESCE(r.rev, 0) AS "星尘收入",
  COALESCE(r.charges, 0) AS "收费次数",
  COALESCE(r.bonus, 0) AS "专项星尘",
  COALESCE(r.insufficient, 0) AS "余额不足",
  c.cost AS "总成本 $",
  c.cost_auto AS "自动成本 $",
  c.cost_manual AS "手动成本 $",
  c.cost_manual / NULLIF(r.charges, 0) AS "每次收费成本 $",
  CASE WHEN c.cost > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.rev, 0) / c.cost END AS "星尘 / $",
  c.calls AS "调用数",
  c.cost_failed AS "报错超时成本 $",
  c.pending AS "待补",
  c.missing AS "缺失"
FROM d LEFT JOIN c USING (day_cn) LEFT JOIN r USING (day_cn)
ORDER BY d.day_cn DESC

panels.title: 近 7 天成本去哪了（美元）
panels.description: 按 状态栏/记忆栏 × 首发/兜底 × 有没有返回 拆开。「有返回」= 模型正常返回了内容（之后被格式检查丢掉的也在这里）；「报错/超时」= 报错、首字超时、截断、流中断等没返回可用结果的调用，它们的花费照样算成本。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE panel WHEN 'status' THEN '状态栏' ELSE '记忆栏' END || ' · '
    || CASE role WHEN 'primary' THEN '首发' ELSE '兜底' END || ' · '
    || CASE WHEN returned THEN '有返回' ELSE '报错/超时' END AS "类别",
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "成本"
FROM analytics.panel_call_costs
WHERE dispatched_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 近 7 天按模型
panels.description: 每个供应商 · 模型 · 首发/兜底 的调用次数与花费。平均每次 = 成本 ÷ 已补到成本的调用数。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  provider AS "供应商",
  model AS "模型",
  CASE role WHEN 'primary' THEN '首发' ELSE '兜底' END AS "角色",
  COUNT(*) AS "调用次数",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT returned) AS "报错/超时",
  SUM(cost_usd) AS "成本 $",
  SUM(cost_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(cost_usd), 0) AS "平均每次 $",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_state = 'pending') AS "待补",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_state = 'missing') AS "缺失"
FROM analytics.panel_call_costs
WHERE dispatched_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
GROUP BY provider, model, role
ORDER BY "成本 $" DESC NULLS LAST, "调用次数" DESC
